Q: PowerShell script not running on startup A:

You need to debug this on your own:

  • firstly, confirm that the job actually runs your powershell files on startup, i.e. create some dummy powershell script, like 'hello world' >> $pathToSomeTextFile, then you can restart the server and see if the specified was updated

  • secondly, you could add more logging to windows event log and analyze if there are any errors, for example

    New-EventLog -LogName Application -Source "MyPowerShellScript"

try {
    # Code that might fail
    Get-Item "C:\does-not-exist.txt" -ErrorAction Stop
}
catch {
    Write-EventLog `
        -LogName Application `
        -Source "MyPowerShellScript" `
        -EventId 1001 `
        -EntryType Error `
        -Message $_.Exception.Message
}

Q: How do I get the 3D rotation from one orthogonal basis to another (quaternion or matrix) A:

The orthogonal & -normal base vectors that describe an orientation are the column vectors of a rotation matrix; i.e. the vectors r=right, u=up, f=forward they form a matrix

r_x u_x f_x
r_y u_y f_y
r_z u_z f_z

This matrix is the rotation matrix to get into that orientation.

So if you have two orientations R and R' then the transformation to get from R to R' is the compound transformation going from R to 𝟙 (identity) which is inv(R) followed by a rotation to R'. i.e.

T(R→R') = R' · inv(R)

Update: What should be mentioned is, that if matrix M is orthonormal (orthogonal and normal), then inv(M) = transpose(M)

Q: Bluetooth connection failed from Raspberry Pi at LE Read Remote Used Features A:

It seems like for some reason your Bluetooth mode was set to bredr, and because your device is a BLE device that does not support Bluetooth Classic -> BR/EDR Not Supported, you were not able to connect. Thus, setting it to dual does the trick. You can set it to dual mode via editing /etc/bluetooth/main.conf. I would expect a same behaviour, if you set it to le as well.

# Restricts all controllers to the specified transport. Default value
# is "dual", i.e. both BR/EDR and LE enabled (when supported by the HW).
# Possible values: "dual", "bredr", "le"
ControllerMode = dual

Q: Html meta keywords should contain commas? A:

Yes, meta keywords traditionally use commas, but it doesn’t matter anymore.

Explanation:
Originally, the meta keywords tag expected a comma-separated list:

<meta name="keywords" content="html, css, seo">

Without commas, older search engines might treat it as one phrase.
However, modern search engines completely ignore the meta keywords tag, so commas (or even the tag itself) have no effect on SEO today.
